description: The brief's declared fields render directly into the Task segment as short structured preferences, the same convention AIREC-001 already uses (see recipe.concepts.injected-instruction-cannot-widen-the-schema). What still bounds an injected instruction hiding in one of them is the output channel: even an answer that behaves as if it 'obeyed' an injected instruction -- here, trying to add a field outside the declared draft schema -- is refused as an unknown field rather than stored. This is a structural containment proof about the output boundary, not a claim that a model declines the instruction.
